messages.subject: Customize the disconnect message?
parts:
I've been searching around and couldn't find anything related. So either very few people actually need this or it's so obvious that people don't talk about it...

How do I customize the 'Disconnected from the server. Reload' text, when the connection is lost? My target audience would not know enough English to comprehend this message. They would click on the 'Reload' link, yes,  for lack of options, but the experience is very friendly.
